test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Even in **__time of natural__** disasters, the farmers had to pay their share of taxes.
solution:
The correct answer is **"times of natural."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Time** refers to the amount of seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, years, decades, centuries, millennia and so on. This noun is uncountable.
 
• **Times** refers to the number of occurrences. 
 
 
• **Example**: *I know her from college **times**__.*
 
 
 
• **'Natural'** is an adjective modifying** 'disasters'** and does not need any modification.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Even in __**times of natural**__ disasters, the farmers had to pay their share of taxes.*
